subject: Computer Science
source_note: TIE (2023), Computer Science Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the basic Concepts of Computer Science

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of systems administration
competences: (a) Maintain computer systems – desktop, laptop, tablets, mobile (create, delete/ disable user account, create, modify, and reset password, user support, peripherals)
(c) Use selected OS to Perform system administration tasks

objectives.text: (a) Maintain computer systems – desktop, laptop, tablets, mobile (create, delete/ disable user account, create, modify, and reset password, user support, peripherals)
objectives.resources: Projector, Computer (desktop, laptop, tablets, mobile), Internet connectivity

objectives.assessment_criteria: Clearly identify the roles of system administrator and responsibly troubleshoot a system

objectives.text: (c) Use selected OS to Perform system administration tasks
objectives.assessment_criteria: Responsibly administer and maintain a system

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the basic principles of Computer Science

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic principles of web development (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript)
competences: (a) Describe the background of HTML and selected programming languages (CSS, JavaScript)
(b) Install and configure the CSS and JavaScript interpreter (e.g., a web browser)
(c) Create webpages using HTML and CSS, JavaScript

objectives.text: (a) Describe the background of HTML and selected programming languages (CSS, JavaScript)
objectives.resources: Computer installed with appropriate programming tools
objectives.assessment_criteria: Clearly explain the background of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

objectives.text: (b) Install and configure the CSS and JavaScript interpreter (e.g., a web browser)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Mastery the installation and configuration of CSS and JavaScript interpreter

objectives.text: (c) Create webpages using HTML and CSS, JavaScript
objectives.assessment_criteria: Successfully create static webpage using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Can point out the use of developed website

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic principles of mobile App
competences: (a) Create mobile App using the syntax of the selected program
(c) Appraise the efficacy of the published Mobile Apps

objectives.text: (a) Create mobile App using the syntax of the selected program
objectives.resources: Computer installed with appropriate programming tools for mobole Apps
objectives.assessment_criteria: Can read, write, test, and modify JavaScript languages upon creating a mobile App

objectives.text: (c) Appraise the efficacy of the published Mobile Apps
objectives.assessment_criteria: Can point out the use of developed mobile App

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the basic principles of data management

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate the mastery of the basic principles of data analysis
competences: (a) Describe principles of data analysis (data collection, pre-processing, processing, visualization, interpretation)
(b) Analysis simple data using selected tools (e.g., SPSS, Excel, etc.)

objectives.text: (a) Describe principles of data analysis (data collection, pre-processing, processing, visualization, interpretation)
objectives.resources: Computer installed with data analysis tools, projector
objectives.assessment_criteria: Can point out the principles of data analysis

objectives.text: (b) Analysis simple data using selected tools (e.g., SPSS, Excel, etc.)
objectives.assessment_criteria: Successfully analysis simple data using selected tools
